draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 231st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 28th of 36 at CB. He went 246th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2022, 26th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 36 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 10.6% (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 10.6% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
